prayerExcerpt.en-US: Let us pray for perseverance in good works.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Oremos pela perseverança nas boas obras.

meta.face: A Provençal shepherd boy of about fifteen, visibly a boy, beardless, sun-browned and lightly FRECKLED across the nose, with a NARROW, LONG, BONY young face tapering to a small, POINTED chin — a high, narrow forehead, a thin, straight nose, very LARGE, clear hazel eyes, thin straight brows bleached pale by the sun, slightly hollow cheeks, a wide, thin mouth in a faint smile, rather LARGE ears standing out from the head; short, straight, sun-bleached straw-coloured hair cut round in a fringe; the gaze open and earnest, toward us.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The book calls him a mere child keeping his mother's sheep when he was inspired to build the bridge; its engraving shows a shepherd boy with his flock before Avignon. The statue on Wikipedia's article shows him young, carrying a great stone on his shoulder, the legend of the first stone. The narrow, freckled face with the pointed chin is our choice, apart from `pancras`'s round boy's face.
